notes.title: Implemented a patch Ver1.3.4.
notes.content:
Implemented a patch Ver1.3.4.

-The cleared stage defense rate display has been corrected to cut off. If the stage defense rate has been displayed as 100.0% but the achievement has not been unlocked, please check the correct stage defense rate.
-The jar that catches magic stones has been a little larger.

Please update to the latest version.

notes.title: Achievement patch(Japanese version) v 1.0.15J NY-a(Jan, 2nd, 2023)
notes.content:
Achievement patch(Japanese version)
The achievements in the Japanese version can be unlocked. All achievements for those who have already progressed in the game are also unlocked (recheck all loaded player status information to unlock achievements).
